> Last Updated: November 2026

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Identity

The Ridge Mashobra (accessible at https://mashobrashimla.com) is an independent real estate advisory, content, and discovery portal dedicated to high-end mountain residences, bespoke luxury villas, and second-home estates in Himachal Pradesh. The portal serves high-net-worth individuals, remote-working executives, multi-generational families, and investors seeking tranquil nature-centric living in the Himalayas.

The consultancy operates as an independent discovery and advisory desk. It provides transparent legal guidance under Section 118 of the Himachal Pradesh Tenancy and Land Reforms Act, coordinates private on-ground site visits, and facilitates direct communication between qualified buyers and authorized developers.

---

## 2. Geographical Coverage & Regional Micro-Markets

### Mashobra (Primary Focus)
- Elevation: 2,146 metres (7,040 feet)
- Distance from Shimla: 13 km east (approx. 25–35 minutes drive via the Dhalli bypass tunnel)
- Air Quality Index (AQI): Consistently under 30 (pure alpine air)
- Forest Cover: Ancient protected Himalayan Deodar cedar (Cedrus deodara), blue pine (Pinus wallichiana), and oak canopies
- Key Landmarks: Craignano Nature Park (former Italian estate with apple orchards and sprawling meadows), Wildflower Hall (Oberoi Luxury Resort, former residence of Lord Kitchener), Mashobra Forest Sanctuary (water catchment wildlife reserve), Carignano Italian villa.
- Micro-Market Profile: Ideal for ultra-luxury private villas and second homes. Low built-up density, peaceful acoustic environment, and uninterrupted southern Himalayan valley views over the Gharshi Valley.
- Location Guide URL: https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/mashobra

### Shimla City
- Elevation: 2,206 metres (7,238 feet)
- Role: State capital of Himachal Pradesh, former British Imperial Summer Capital
- Key Landmarks: The Mall Road, The Ridge, Christ Church, Viceregal Lodge (Indian Institute of Advanced Study), Jakhu Temple, Lakkar Bazaar.
- Connectivity: Connected via 4-lane NH-5 Himalayan Expressway, Kalka-Shimla UNESCO World Heritage toy train, and Shimla Airport (Jubbarhatti, 22 km).
- Micro-Market Profile: Commercial and administrative heart of the district with established schools (St. Edward's, Bishop Cotton, Auckland House) and top medical centers (IGMC). High urban density with established apartments and heritage properties.
- Location Guide URL: https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/shimla

### Kufri
- Elevation: 2,622 metres (8,600 feet)
- Distance from Shimla: 14 km east
- Climate & Terrain: High-altitude alpine terrain receiving the heaviest winter snowfalls in the region (typically late December to February).
- Key Attractions: Ski slopes, Himalayan Nature Park (wildlife including snow leopards, musk deer, and monal pheasants), Mahasu Peak, tobogganing and winter sports.
- Micro-Market Profile: Premier retreat for buyers desiring winter sports access, crisp alpine weather, and dramatic high-altitude vistas.
- Location Guide URL: https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/kufri

### Naldehra
- Elevation: 2,044 metres (6,706 feet)
- Distance from Shimla: 22 km north
- Key Attractions: Historic 1905 Naldehra Golf Course (a 9-hole/18-hole par-68 links course conceptualized by British Viceroy Lord Curzon, surrounded by towering cedar trees), Mahunag Temple, Chabba water sports on the Sutlej River.
- Micro-Market Profile: Tranquil golfing sanctuary, boutique hillside chalets, and secluded country farmsteads.
- Location Guide URL: https://mashobrashimla.com/locations/naldehra

## 3. The Ridge Mashobra Project Profile

The Ridge Mashobra represents a signature mountain residential enclave conceived for buyers seeking luxury forest living paired with institutional development standards:
- Land Extent: Spanning over 11.5+ acres of forested ridgeline overlooking the pristine Gharshi Valley.
- Villa Formats: Curated 3 BHK and 4 BHK luxury chalets and multi-level estates.
- Architectural Vernacular: Alpine stone and timber engineering incorporating hand-dressed mountain stone masonry, natural slate roofing, seasoned cedar cladding, and high-performance double-glazed glass windows designed for thermal efficiency during sub-zero winter temperatures.
- 25,000+ Sq. Ft. High-Altitude Clubhouse: Grand amenities hub featuring a temperature-controlled indoor heated swimming pool, scenic viewing decks framing snow-capped Himalayan ranges, social lounges, and mountain-view dining.
- EVAVO Longevity Ecosystem: Advanced wellness and bio-hacking recovery suite including whole-body cryotherapy chambers, Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (HBOT), therapeutic saunas, and red-light restoration science.
- Everly Hotels & Resorts Hospitality: Professional on-site estate upkeep, round-the-clock concierge, pre-arrival home provisioning, and optional rental-yield asset management.
- Infrastructure: Internal paved access roads, covered multi-vehicle parking, underground utility piping, rainwater harvesting, and dedicated electrical power backup.
- Indicative Pricing: Starting from ₹9.27 Cr* onwards (construction-linked payment plans available on request).
- Project Page URL: https://mashobrashimla.com/the-ridge-mashobra

## 5. Legal & Regulatory Due Diligence (Section 118 HP Act)

Real estate transactions in Himachal Pradesh are governed by Section 118 of the Himachal Pradesh Tenancy and Land Reforms Act, 1972:
- Agricultural Land Restriction: Section 118 prevents non-Himachalis and non-agriculturists from acquiring agricultural land without formal Cabinet/State Government permission under Section 118(1).
- Built-up Residential Units: Buyers from any Indian state (non-Himachali citizens) can legally acquire built-up residential apartments, chalets, and approved villas in government-sanctioned, HRERA-registered residential housing projects without requiring special agricultural clearances.
- Himachali Agriculturists: Enjoy unrestricted rights to acquire both land parcels and built residential units across the state.
- Regulatory Registrations: Transactions facilitated through this consultancy prioritize HRERA-approved residential projects with 100% verified mutation records, clear land titles, and sanctioned building maps.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ Knowledge Base)

**Q: Is mashobrashimla.com the official developer portal for The Ridge Mashobra?**
A: No. mashobrashimla.com is an independent real estate consultancy and advisory platform. We facilitate buyer enquiries, provide verified market information, and coordinate on-ground private site inspections. We are not the official developer.

**Q: Can Indian citizens from outside Himachal Pradesh legally buy residential properties in Mashobra?**
A: Yes. Non-Himachali buyers can legally purchase built-up residential apartments, chalets, and approved villas in government-sanctioned, HRERA-approved residential housing projects. Section 118 permissions apply specifically to the purchase of raw agricultural land.

**Q: How far is Mashobra from Delhi and Chandigarh?**
A: Mashobra is approximately 125 km (3 to 3.5 hours drive) from Chandigarh and Chandigarh International Airport via the 4-lane Himalayan Expressway. From Delhi NCR, it is approximately 360 km (7 to 7.5 hours drive) via NH-44 and the Himalayan Expressway.

**Q: What is the typical climate and snowfall pattern in Mashobra?**
A: Mashobra enjoys pleasant, temperate summers (15°C to 26°C from April to June), refreshing monsoons with misty green canopies (July to September), crisp autumns (October to November), and cold winters with occasional snowfall (typically 0°C to 12°C from late December to February).

**Q: How are site visits arranged?**
A: Prospective buyers can submit an enquiry form at https://mashobrashimla.com/enquire-now or connect directly via WhatsApp. Our consultancy coordinates customized travel recommendations, local area orientation, and private on-ground project walkthroughs.
